# Concepts to Code: Building Good Computational Research Practices with R

Sept 2 & 3, 2026 Berry 180A (The LINK) Baker-Berry Library, Dartmouth College

## Before the Workshop Begins

Download R and RStudio following the [instructions here](https://rstudio-education.github.io/hopr/starting.html).

## What to bring

1.  Laptop and charger (unless your battery can last all day)
2.  *Optional*: a research project you are interested in starting (with data)
3.  Come with an open mind ready to learn

- [Registration Page](https://libcal.dartmouth.edu/event/17272420) with workshop description. *Note: register for both days!*
